protocol: 13 fixed channel configurations evaluated with outer leave-one-subject-out; no channel subset or hyperparameter is selected using outer-test labels
selection_policy: confirmatory fixed design: all channels + six leave-one-channel-out + six single-channel configurations
ranking_policy: rankings are descriptive only; outer-test rankings are not used to select a channel subset for refitting or for any additional test on the same folds
preprocessing: feature StandardScaler and raw-signal channel mean/std are fitted on the 23 outer-training subjects only, then applied unchanged to the held-out subject
seed_policy: deterministic seed derived independently from configuration, outer subject, and model; resume order cannot change deep-model results
